FROM ActorDirector
GROUP BY actor_id, director_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3;

complexity.notes: Grouped aggregation across composite actor-director keys executes in linear scan time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Grouping only by actor misses director relationships; self-joins multiply rows needlessly.

solutions.code:
SELECT actor_id, director_id
FROM ActorDirector
GROUP BY actor_id, director_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3;

import pandas as pd

def actors_and_directors(actor_director: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    counts = actor_director.groupby(['actor_id', 'director_id']).size().reset_index(name='count')
    res = counts[counts['count'] >= 3]
    return res[['actor_id', 'director_id']]
